content.summary: Proceed with conservative declaration aliases and explicitly conditional semantic correspondences under the audited fact-alignment plan. Frozen P8 has no extra exact-alias pairs; a zero automatic match gain is expected and cannot justify loosening the rule.
findings: Require a total bijection, exact metadata for automatic aliases and explicit assumptions for every changed declaration. No similarity, same-name guess, dropped exception, numeric-unit conversion or caller-supplied approval can authorize matching.
Rename parsed AST fact leaves simultaneously and translate complete tagged snapshots. Replay witnesses in both original Java classes, not merely the normalized solver copy.

Conditional comparisons remain nested under CONDITIONAL_ANALYSIS, with no unconditional grouping or release authority even when encoded rules agree. Output-meaning correspondence is an explicit unresolved assumption.
The baseline is the unchanged P8 evidence; tests include swapped aliases, all 243 Boolean combinations with missing values, semantic changes, malformed maps and original-language witness questions.
No live model calls occur; failures trigger focused repair. This phase establishes an engineering transformation, not legal meaning or human review.
